articles.author: zy j
articles.description:
A weekly review → next-week plan micro-service (consumer AI that ships outcomes)


A lot of productivity tools are fun… but they don’t change behavior.
One routine does: the weekly review.
A tiny service (or app later) that turns messy inputs into a clean weekly plan.
Input:
a brain dump (5–10 minutes)
or a few screenshots / notes
Output:
Key principle: deliverables, not chat.
People already search for weekly review templates and prompts.
1) Write a post with before/after screenshots:
“Here’s a messy brain dump → here’s a clean plan.”
2) Offer a limited free batch:
“I’ll do 10 weekly plans for free today. Comment ‘PLAN’.”
3) Measure:
% of people who send real inputs
how many come back next week (retention)
whether they ask for reminders / accountability
If this existed as a $5/week or $9/month service, would you try it?
If you want a quick example, drop a short brain dump in the comments (or a link to a doc). I’ll turn it into a plan and reply with the result.
Context:
Weekly review templates (example): https://noteplan.co/templates/ai-weekly-review-planning-template

Notion weekly review instructions template: https://www.notion.com/templates/weekly-review-ai-assistant-ai-instructions
articles.title: A weekly review next-week plan micro-service (consumer AI that ships outcomes)
